psychological_meaning: Solid Pink evokes feelings of romance, nurturing, and calm. It's often associated with femininity and can promote a sense of comfort and security. It can also be seen as representing playfulness and lightheartedness, balancing sophistication with a touch of innocence.

real_world_examples.title: Rose Quartz Crystal
